'''B-7G''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] which worked in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Within the [[City/Legends|city]] he worked alongside the receptionist [[Bea]] at the reception desk in [[Figg Hall]], a building in the [[Tourist District]] designed to allow the public to meet with representatives of Cloud City.<ref name="TJoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bea first appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. B-7G is listed as a character players might encounter, but no specific interactions are listed.
